import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source CSV files into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and types
        df = df[['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']]

        # Enforce data types as per target schema
        df['admit'] = df['admit'].astype(int)
        df['gre'] = df['gre'].astype(int)
        df['gpa'] = df['gpa'].astype(float)
        df['prestige'] = df['prestige'].astype(int)

        dfs.append(df)

    # Since all source tables have the exact same schema as the target,
    # we perform a union (concatenation) of all source tables.
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_93/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
